# DeHub

> DeHub (dehub.io) is an open source, user-owned and censorship-resistant social network and mobile app, in development since 2021. Posts can be minted on-chain, creators keep their audience and up to 99% of their revenue, and the network runs on the DHB token (Base and BNB Chain) for tips, watch-to-earn rewards, staking and governance. Not to be confused with DePaul University's DeHUB portal or Rowan's DEHub.

Every link below is a public page that renders without an account. The app's signed-in screens (messages, wallet, notifications, settings) are private and not listed. Machine-readable API access for assistants is described in [skill.md](https://dehub.io/skill.md).

## Start here

- [DeHub home](https://dehub.io/): What DeHub is, the latest public posts and links into every section.
- [What is DeHub?](https://dehub.io/guides/what-is-dehub): Plain-English explainer of the platform, the team and DeHub tokens.
- [Documentation](https://dehub.io/docs): Index of the official docs — platform, dApps, token, staking, governance, roadmap and FAQ.
- [DeHub overview](https://dehub.io/docs/overview): How the platform fits together.
- [FAQ](https://dehub.io/docs/faq): Answers to the most common questions about DeHub and tokens.

## Watch, listen and browse

- [Explore](https://dehub.io/explore): Every public post in chronological order, filterable by format and hashtag.
- [Videos](https://dehub.io/videos): The latest long-form videos from DeHub creators.
- [Shorts](https://dehub.io/shorts): Vertical short-form video feed.
- [Music](https://dehub.io/music): Tracks and audio from DeHub artists.
- [DeHub TV](https://dehub.io/tv): Free live TV channels from around the world alongside creator live streams.
- [Cinema](https://dehub.io/cinema): Where to stream, rent or buy any film or series, with live prices by country.
- [Stages](https://dehub.io/stages): Live audio rooms, kept afterwards as recordings with transcripts.
- [Communities](https://dehub.io/communities): Public groups around a topic, each with its own feed.
- [Arcade](https://dehub.io/arcade): Browser games and worlds built and open sourced by DeHub.

## Create and earn

- [Become a creator](https://dehub.io/creators): Apply to the creator program and see how creators earn on DeHub.
- [Creator Studio](https://dehub.io/creator): AI image, video, audio and 3D generation.
- [Bounties](https://dehub.io/work): Paid tasks with an escrowed budget, open to anyone.
- [Import a video](https://dehub.io/converter): Publish a video from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and 17 other platforms.
- [Migrate a whole profile](https://dehub.io/migrate-youtube): Bulk-import a channel or profile to DeHub.
- [Builder](https://dehub.io/builder): Build and host a mini app by messaging the DeHub assistant.
- [DeHub Extra](https://dehub.io/premium): Premium membership perks and pricing.
- [Pricing](https://dehub.io/pricing): Creator Studio plans.

- [Token overview](https://dehub.io/docs/token/overview): What DeHub tokens are and which chains it runs on.
- [Token economics](https://dehub.io/docs/token/economics): Supply, emissions and allocation.
- [Where to buy tokens](https://dehub.io/docs/token/where-to-buy): Exchanges and on-ramps that list tokens.
- [Staking tokens](https://dehub.io/docs/token/stake): How staking works and what badges it unlocks.
- [Governance](https://dehub.io/docs/token/governance): How proposals and voting work.
- [DEX](https://dehub.io/dex): Trade tokens with limit orders on Base or BNB Chain.
- [Bridge](https://dehub.io/bridge): Move tokens between Base and BNB Chain.
